decisions.detail: event set: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
sample space: Some curricula call this the possibility space or outcome space.
theoretical probability: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
simplified fraction: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
equally likely: Some curricula say equiprobable outcomes or a fair/unbiased experiment.
relative frequency: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
trial: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
number of trials: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
n(S): The book writes the number of elements of a set as n(S), n(A), n(B). Other curricula use |S|, #S or card(S) for the same thing.
region: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
identity: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
union: Other curricula may say 'A or B' (the label used by one finder) rather than 'union of two events'; the symbol ∪ is the same.
intersection: Other curricula may say 'A and B' (the label used by one finder) rather than 'intersection of two events'; the symbol ∩ is the same.
mutually exclusive: A reader from another curriculum may know this as "disjoint" events (events with an empty intersection).
complementary events: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
complement: The book writes the complement of A as A'; other curricula commonly write A^c or a barred A (and some say 'not A').
empty set: not in the Egyptian Prep-3 maths book's vocabulary
